group_assessment.counts_measured: PubMed esearch 2026-10-31: 'Mahajan NP[au]' 91; 'Mahajan NP[au] AND WWOX' 2; 'Mahajan NP[au] AND (ACK1 OR TNK2)' 31. Author-name ambiguity is possible (initials search); the senior author's identity was not disambiguated beyond the initials.
group_assessment.weighting: A kinase-signalling group in prostate cancer (ACK1 is the group's main subject); WWOX is a substrate they found by mass spectrometry. Their ACK1 measurements carry full weight; their WWOX conclusions are weighted as overexpression observations in non-neural cells, with the degradation step carried by one blot.
group_assessment.note: WWOX is not the group's field; the senior ACK1 literature is cited by later WWOX reviews as the source of the ACK1 -> WWOX mechanism.

verbatim_locators.abstract_anchoring_waived: No locator is taken from the abstract; every entry is attested from a rendered page of the article body or a figure.
verbatim_locators.note: COVERAGE: full text of the 10-page PDF read, including figure legends 1-8, from the extracted text layer and from rendered pages. The text layer of this PDF carries six C0 control characters where the multiplication sign of Methods cell counts should be, so it is not used as an evidentiary surface (rule 5d/5e): every locator is a rendered-page attestation of pages 5-8. FIGURES INSPECTED AS IMAGES: every numbered figure (Figs 1-3 at 110 dpi, Figs 4-8 at 130 dpi); panel-level attestation is recorded for Fig 4D-F, 5, 6B, 7B, 8 and, as context, Figs 1-3. SUPPLEMENT: Supplementary Figs S1-S2 are cited and are not part of the PDF (unavailable). Linearity of the Wwox bands in Fig 5E and Fig 8A was not assessed. The Greek capital delta of Wwox-delta5-8 is quoted as printed.

entries.proposition: M1a: in overexpressed HEK293T a constitutively active Ack1 (caAck) tyrosine-phosphorylates Flag-Wwox far more than wild-type Ack1 does; the system is overexpression, non-neural.
entries.snippet: Kinase-competent wAck1 minimally increased Wwox tyrosine phosphorylation, but caAck1 was far more effective
entries.anchor: Results, 'Ack1 associates with the tumor suppressor Wwox', Fig 5D 2 lane 3

entries.proposition: M1b: Wwox polyubiquitination is seen with caAck in the same overexpression system.
entries.snippet: Substantial Wwox polyubiquitination was observed in cells cotransfected with caAck
entries.anchor: Results, 'Activated Ack1 promotes Wwox polyubiquitination and degradation', first paragraph, Fig 5D 6

entries.proposition: M6: the isoform lacking exons 5-8 is neither phosphorylated nor polyubiquitinated; site and ADH domain are confounded in this isoform.
entries.snippet: In contrast, Wwox∆5-8 was neither tyrosine phosphorylated nor polyubiquitinated when coexpressed with caAck
entries.anchor: Results, same section, Fig 5D 6 lane 7 (the text derivation renders the Greek delta as D)

entries.proposition: M2 (text side): the reduction in Wwox protein is stated for full-length Wwox with caAck in a 3 h cycloheximide experiment; the sentence draws the degradation conclusion.
entries.snippet: Coexpression of caAck1 resulted in reduction in Wwox protein (Fig. 5E, 1, lane 2)
entries.anchor: Results, 'Activated Ack1 promotes Wwox polyubiquitination and degradation', third paragraph, Fig 5E

entries.proposition: M2 (panel side): Fig 5E has four lanes, all headed +caAck; Wwox and WwoxD5-8 each without and with CHX (3 h). Full-length Wwox signal drops in lane 2; the D5-8 band is similar in lanes 3-4; actin below. One blot, no quantification, no lane without activated Ack1.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 5E read at 130 dpi; header '+caAck' spans all lanes; lanes 1-4 = Wwox -/+ CHX, WwoxD5-8 -/+ CHX.

entries.proposition: M3 (text side): the only route evidence on endogenous Wwox is ubiquitination revealed after MG-132; no level rescue is stated.
entries.snippet: MG-132 treatment resulted in detection of polyubiquitinated endogenous Wwox (Fig. 5F, lanes 2 and 4)

entries.proposition: M3 (panel side): Fig 5F header '+caAck' over LNCaP and 293T, lanes - + - + MG132, IP Wwox, IB Ub with a smear in the + MG132 lanes (2 and 4); no vector or kinase-dead lane; no Wwox level blot besides actin.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 5F read at 130 dpi.

entries.proposition: M3 (external): the manuscript cites a different group for proteasome-dependent accumulation of a truncated Wwox with MG-132; this is a citation inside the paper, not data of the paper.
entries.snippet: Watanabe et al. (53) showed accumulation of a truncated Wwox protein of approximate molecular weight of 26 kDa by inhibiting proteasomal degradation with MG-132 treatment

entries.proposition: M5: Y33F Wwox is still phosphorylated and polyubiquitinated by caAck, so the ubiquitination-targeting site differs from the Tyr33 stress site.
entries.snippet: The Y33F mutant was tyrosine phosphorylated and polyubiquitinated by caAck1
entries.anchor: Results, 'Ack1 tyrosine phosphorylates Wwox predominantly at Tyr287 and not Tyr33', Fig 6B 1

entries.proposition: M5 (panel side): Fig 6B lanes 1-2 (+caAck, Wwox and Y33F) show p-Wwox and a Ub-Wwox smear; lanes 3-4 (+kdAck) show weak Ub signal. The legend title speaks of degradation but no level or chase panel is shown for Y33F.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 6B read at 130 dpi.

entries.proposition: M4a: Tyr287 is named predominant, not the only, site, from phosphotyrosine signal of single-site Tyr-to-Phe mutants.
entries.snippet: This indicates that Tyr287 is the predominant but perhaps not the only phosphorylation site
entries.anchor: Results, 'Ack1 tyrosine phosphorylates Wwox predominantly at Tyr287', Fig 7B

entries.proposition: M4b (panel side): Fig 7B, seven Tyr-to-Phe mutants plus wild type, all +caAck, IP Flag, IB pTyr: Y287F (lane 2) has the faintest p-Wwox but a trace remains; Y375F (lane 7) is also weaker than wild type. Only p-Wwox, total Wwox and p-Ack1 are blotted; no ubiquitin or chase panel for any mutant.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 7B read at 130 dpi; no quantification printed.

entries.proposition: M4c: the authors infer the role of Tyr287 in degradation in the Discussion ('second hit'); it is stated as speculation.
entries.snippet: diminishing functional Wwox protein is COOH-terminal Wwox tyrosine phosphorylation at Tyr287, targeting Wwox for polyubiquitination and degradation

entries.proposition: M7a: correlation in human prostate samples is a difference of total Ack1 versus phospho-Ack1 between groups; Fig 8 images were not inspected.
entries.snippet: AICaP and benign prostate samples had similar total Ack1
entries.anchor: Results, 'Androgen-independent prostate tumor specimens exhibit increased tyrosine-phosphorylated Ack1 and decreased Wwox', Fig 8B

entries.proposition: M7b: Wwox is lower in the tumour group; the authors word it as suggesting, not demonstrating.
entries.snippet: compared with benign prostate samples, Wwox levels were reduced significantly in AICaP

entries.proposition: M8: the only inhibitor used on Ack1 activity is geldanamycin (Hsp90); the experiment measures Ack1 kinase activity and tumour growth, not Wwox level.
entries.snippet: The caAck kinase activity was reduced to basal level on geldanamycin treatment (Fig. 4D)

entries.proposition: M8 (panel side): Fig 4D/E: geldanamycin 5 uM for 8 h reduces caAck kinase activity to near vector level (D) and removes the p-Ack band (E); Fig 4F: tumour growth delayed (n=10). No Wwox level is blotted in any Fig 4 panel.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 4D, 4E, 4F read at 130 dpi.

entries.proposition: M7c (panel side): Fig 8A/B, AICaP versus benign prostate, n=16 per group: Wwox band weak in AICaP lanes and strong in BP lanes in the printed blot; bar chart phospho-Ack1 higher (p<0.02), total Ack1 similar (p=0.67), Wwox lower (p=0.02). Between-group correlation of band intensity; no per-sample pairing printed.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 8A-B read at 130 dpi.

entries.proposition: C1: the activated kinase construct is a point mutant (caAck = L487F) of a C-terminally truncated Ack1; kinase-dead is K158R; truncated constructs lack residues 788-1036. All Wwox work therefore uses a truncated, engineered activated kinase, not endogenous full-length Ack1.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 2A domain scheme: Ack1, wAck, kdAck(K158R), caAck(L487F); Fig 2D kinase assay: caAck about 7-fold higher than kdAck. Figs 1-2 contain no Wwox panel.

entries.proposition: C2: caAck-expressing LNCaP cells form tumours in nude mice (n=10) and grow in soft agar; this is the tumorigenesis context the Wwox mechanism is offered to explain. No Wwox panel in Fig 3.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 3A growth curves modest difference; 3B soft agar colonies caAck; 3C tumour volume caAck rises by day 23, others near zero.
